text_block_list.text: No worries...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way back from my first shrine visit
of the year, I happen to hear indistinct
mumbling
coming from the side of the
street.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: No worries at aaall...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
<username>?! Is
that
really you?!
choice_data_list: Inside the snow hut... is that Ms....

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Sniff! You've got to help me! I'm about to die from the cold!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp... Ahhh! That brought me right back from the brink! ☆ It really isn't New Year's without some food and a swig of hot amazake to wash it down with! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, I gave my master a little
friendly poke in the derriere with a
needle as a way to
liven up the new
year...
choice_data_list: Why were you in a place like that?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But I failed miserably and got kicked
out!
Teehee! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Give me a break! Stop talking like I always fail! Hic!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I may not look it, but even I nail the
treatment
sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Let me prove it to you right now! ☆ Just
think of
it as my New Year's gift to
you! ♪ M'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I scramble to put myself a safe distance
from her,
but she quickly blocks my only
escape path!
choice_data_list: I'll pass on getting treated by a ...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come onnn! ♪ Name a chakra you
want
activated, and I'll get down to
business! Lesh go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess I have no choice but to grin and
bear with
it!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Aaall righty! ☆ Ready, steady, hic!
choice_data_list: I-It's a pressure point that makes...
Press the pressure point that make...
Like a pressure point that makes y...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelming power surges through
every single pore of my body, and I feel
much more clearheaded. The treatment
is a resounding
success!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hic... Well, am I da best or whaaat?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Snrk! Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I carry her snoozing form to the sofa,
I entertain the thought that maybe, just
maybe,
she's a better acupuncturist
when inebriated.
